The effect of throughfall exclusion on ECM fungal diversity indices differed between beech and spruce, irrespective of the competitive situation. In 2016, there was a significant difference in the morphotype diversity indices between beech (control: 1.01 ± 0.08; throughfall exclusion: 0.80 ± 0.02) and spruce (control: 0.93 ± 0.21; throughfall exclusion: 0.27 ± 0.11) depending on the treatment (throughfall exclusion × BB vs. SS interaction: p < .01), with a much stronger decline being observed in spruce.
